meta.note: Built by `python -m mpstruc.ligands build` from the mpstruc snapshot: for each chemical component (and class), in how many mpstruc structures it is a ligand (n) and in how many of those the curators' text names it (named); n_title / named_title count the structures whose PDB title mentions it by a name, n_guess / named_guess those where the title only names an abbreviation or an unexplained compound that may be it. 'named' is what a text matcher found, not a curator's own record: labels.by_direct were read in the curators' text, by_fit matched by a code or family word, by_sole inferred because the text names one more compound than the ligands explain. held_out.text_matches_only is the score without the inferred labels.
